nested_ranges: Qwen_current_inclusive contains Qwen_vision; do not sum them.
backward_inclusive can contain checkpoint forward recomputation/SyncBN/collective dependencies; attribute child events by timeline/flows, not adding inclusive ranges.
timing_and_overlap.current_stream_events: CUDA_stream_ms sums current-stream event intervals for calls (35-41,51-54). It includes host launch gaps and stream waits; is not kernel-only or an all-stream exclusive partition.
timing_and_overlap.host_wall: host_dispatch_seconds is perf_counter wall around the call; includes nested work, blocking/sync and waits. It is not CPU busy time, nor a quantity to subtract from CUDA_stream_ms.
timing_and_overlap.nccl: train_vla.py:289-290 uses ZeRO2 overlap_comm/reduce_scatter. Other communication streams can overlap compute. NCCL kernel durations are not exclusive communication overhead or proof of a blocking critical path.
timing_and_overlap.gpu_busy_method: Within a chosen actual marker window W on one rank/device, clip all captured GPU kernel/memcpy/memset intervals on every stream to W and take interval UNION. Do not sum kernel durations, operator self time, nested stages or eight ranks.
timing_and_overlap.trace_idle_method: length(W) minus the captured GPU interval union gives trace-visible device inactivity, not proof of physical-device idle or a host cause. Check missing activities, peer-rank/collective dependencies, runtime API synchronization and CPU worker/thread activity.
timing_and_overlap.host_gap: Correlate CPU launch/flow with kernels. CPU work during all-stream trace silence can support a launch-starvation hypothesis, but I/O, synchronization/dependencies and uncaptured work must be excluded. with_stack=False cannot provide Python-line stacks. Data/CPU preprocessing in worker threads can be outside encode_current scope (train_vla.py:421-443).
timing_and_overlap.rank_aggregation: max-rank host and CUDA columns may come from different ranks. Do not sum their maxima; compare per-rank update/marker-aligned timelines. Clock offsets across separate rank traces are not assumed aligned.
timing_and_overlap.table_limitation: key_averages top80 self_cuda_time_total is cumulative operator cost ranking, not a mutually exclusive wall-time breakdown.
